prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after pet/companion selection, wait time countdowns, pet control tutorial screens, personality headlines, and specific hints (duration, account sync, pet persistence) consistently won.
Major redesigns, trait selector sub-flows, photo guidance copy, benefits story copy, path time headlines, account recovery hints, and reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Notifications, layout modifications, incentives, permission checks, and wait screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Flow bypasses yielded mixed results, winning in round 1 but hurting performance in round 3.
Predictions overestimated gains for major redesigns, trait selector flows, copy changes, and reordering sign-in after photo upload.
Predictions underestimated gains for pet control tutorial screens, wait countdowns, personality headlines, path duration hints, and account safety/persistence hints.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop tray icon control tutorial screen: Adds a dedicated tutorial screen before the final welcome screen explaining desktop tray icon controls and pet visibility toggles. (why: Support receives multiple emails from users confused about how to reveal, control, or hide their pet after setup.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet mascot greeting screen: Adds an engaging mascot greeting screen prior to path selection to introduce the desktop pet concept. (why: Path selection drop-off is 15.4% and has long decision times; introducing the mascot early sets warm expectations.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Full-bleed story screen layout redesign: Redesigns the onboarding story intro screen using a full-bleed visual layout for an immersive first impression. (why: Initial story presentation sets the tone; full-bleed layout improves visual engagement right at entry.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account sign-in security reassurance hint: Adds an account persistence hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that signing in locks in pet retention. (why: Top support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen live progress timer: Enables countdown timer estimates and step progress counter on the waiting screen while rendering the pet model. (why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s; showing active live timer feedback reduces drop-off during rendering.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Companion archetype choice headline copy: Updates path selection screen headline to focus on selecting a daily companion archetype. (why: Personality-focused headlines won in past tests by providing immediate clarity on path choice benefits.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop taskbar pet location hint: Adds a helpful hint on the final setup screen detailing where the pet icon is located on the taskbar. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing on desktop or users failing to find open instances.)
7: [home, notification] Wait screen ready notification toggle: Adds an opt-in completion notification alert on the wait screen so users can safely switch windows during rendering. (why: Long mean wait duration (over 38 minutes) leads to app abandonment without completion alerts.)
8: [finish, layout] Compact finish screen layout: Switches the home intro screen layout to compact mode with direct launch CTAs. (why: Finish stage mean duration is 5815s; compact layout speeds up final onboarding exit into active pet use.)

scores.note: Pet control tutorial screens consistently win and target support confusion at finish step.
Adding sub-flow screens before path selection adds friction and typically hurts performance.
Major redesigns and story visual changes consistently hurt conversion in past tests.
Top support issue addressed directly by pet persistence hint, a proven winning pattern.
Wait countdowns consistently win and directly address long rendering wait duration.
Personality headlines consistently won in historical tests despite general copy test weakness.
Specific hints address known user confusion at the highest drop-off finish stage.
Notification changes showed no clear effect in previous testing rounds.
Layout modifications showed mixed/no clear historical effect, but finish layout had mild positive lift.
